name: Second Hand
description: Second Hand shows your kiosk's own voice timers on a Bluetooth wall clock, and keeps the clock's time right.
author: Mike Janofsky

settings.title: Clock address
settings.description: Filled in by Pair clock and cleared by Forget clock.

settings.title: Show status tile
settings.description: Shows Second Hand's status on the Remote Admin Overview.

confirm.title: Pair the clock?
confirm.message: Hold the clock's button until its light pulses orange first.

buttons.title: Forget clock
buttons.label: Forget
buttons.description: Unpairs the clock so another can be paired.

confirm.title: Forget the clock?
confirm.message: Pair the clock again to use it.
